name: Royal India Delmar
notes: Own site. Menu is served as scanned page images (images/dinner1-6.jpg) plus a separate lunch-specials image; downloaded and read visually. Address on final menu page (3860 Valley Center Drive, San Diego) matches work-list address. 107 dishes covering Exotic Appetizers, Savory Soups, Fresh Salads, Side Orders, Fresh Baked Breads (leavened + whole wheat), Tandoori Specialities, Curry Specialities, Royal Curries (build-your-own — recorded at the Chicken tier price with other-protein prices noted in each description), Biryani Rice Specialties, Vegetable Specialties, Royal Dinners for Two, Kids Meal, and Homemade Desserts. Separate Monday-Friday Lunch Specials image (build-your-own curry, lower prices) was reviewed but not transcribed as a duplicate combinatorial section — dinner menu used as the primary capture.
